run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch remained blocked by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), confirmed against www.tenders.nsw.gov.au and consistent with recent prior runs, so no tender detail page or specification document could be opened and all opportunities are captured at headline level from search snippets only. Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search; concrete recently-published/open opportunities were captured for AusTender (Federal Court, Defence/ASCA, Open Arms/Defence health) and NSW (Destination NSW via buy.nsw). Tier 2 covered local government (VendorPanel; a Cootamundra-Gundagai council RFT captured), government-owned water corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, SA Water surfaced via aggregator discovery signals and flagged for verification), plus GBEs (Powerlink, Transgrid, NBN Co, Australia Post). Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue, EstimateOne): corporate opportunity detail is login/registration-gated and none was publicly visible, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. New buyer-originated sources found: SSROC (Southern Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils) procurement, Powerlink tenders portal, and the John Holland (VIC) subcontractor portal.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of a degraded run, same as recent prior runs): WebFetch to external hosts is denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), confirmed this run against www.tenders.nsw.gov.au. This is an organisation egress policy and was not retried or routed around per proxy guidance. Only WebSearch (US-based, via Anthropic) and the GitHub MCP were reachable.

Because no external detail page or specification document could be opened, deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contacts could not be extracted for ANY entry; all 9 tenders are headline-level and pending a detail pass. Fields not present in search snippets are left null/"" rather than inferred.

Tier 1: AusTender and all state/territory portals could only be read through WebSearch snippets, not their live ATM/RFT lists or feeds, so full lists and pagination could not be swept. Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL and ACT Tenders returned only portal landing pages / status notices in search (no specific current opportunities surfaced this run); Tenders SA also advertised a scheduled outage 6:15-6:45pm ACDT on 17 September 2026.

Queensland: QTenders is mid-migration to VendorPanel (supply.qld.gov.au); the only QLD item surfaced (Preferred Supplier Panel for Grocery, Dairy and Beverages) had already closed on 03 September 2026 and was excluded as not current.

Tier 2 water corporations (Sydney Water 'Strategic Customer Engagement 2026-2029' market capability RFI, Melbourne Water 'Cardinia Dam Upgrade - Construct Only' EOI, SA Water 'Millicent Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrade' EOI) were surfaced via aggregator discovery signals (australiantenders.com.au / govmarket.com.au), not the buyer portals directly. They are recorded against the buyer's own source but their tender IDs, closing dates, values and documents are UNVERIFIED and need confirmation on an authenticated/unblocked run; some aggregator snippets may be stale.

A NSW 'Beacon Crescent Watermain Construction' RFT (released 20 Aug 2026, closing 16 Sep 2026 10am) surfaced without a named buying council in the snippet; omitted to avoid a headless entry - needs the originating council identified before capture.

Tier 3 SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: no specific currently-open, publicly-visible Australian RFx could be confirmed via search (results were generic platform/how-to pages). Corporate opportunities on Ariba/Coupa/BHP/Rio Tinto Buy Local/EstimateOne are registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals in discovered_sources, not as tenders. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Several AusTender items surfaced as pre-release / market-sounding notices rather than open RFTs (PRN9254 Open Arms mental health services; JASD/RFT/20200/1 Defence, effective Sep 2026; JHC/RFP/2025/1 Defence health, down-select). These are flagged with procurement_type=market-sounding and current_status=recently-published; the down-select JHC/RFP/2025/1 was excluded as invitation-only to shortlisted tenderers.
recommended_seed_additions: https://ssroc.nsw.gov.au/procurement/tenders-and-eoi/ - SSROC (Southern Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils) shared procurement / tenders & EOI page; buyer-originated regional council grouping not previously in the known-source list.
https://www.powerlink.com.au/tenders - Powerlink Queensland (state-owned transmission GBE) supplier/tenders portal; posts opportunities via VendorPanel (Queensland Procurement Solution).
https://portal.tenderlink.com/johnhollandvic/alltenders - John Holland (Victoria) buyer-hosted subcontractor/trade-package portal for construction work packages.
https://www.buyingfor.vic.gov.au - Buying for Victoria front-end (companion/rebrand alongside tenders.vic.gov.au); confirm whether it supersedes the legacy portal.
